name: Kochab
description: A naked-eye star 40.1 parsecs away, 44.1 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the Navy Precision Optical Interferometer.

radius.source: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 131873: radius 44.13 +/- 0.22 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 10.229 +/- 0.012 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax

temperature.source: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 131873: effective temperature 4008 +/- 37 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit

gravity.source: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 131873: log g 1.83, from Valdes et al. (2004), as the paper lists it beside the diameter (Table 4)

radialVelocity.source: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331, XHIP, HIP 72607: RV 16.96 +/- 0.19 km/s (quality A)

distance.source: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 131873: the Hipparcos (van Leeuwen 2007) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 24.91 +/- 0.12 mas, inverted

position.credit: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry

text.card: A naked-eye star 40 parsecs away whose disc the NPOI measured: 44.1 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 10.229 milliarcseconds, which gives 44.13 solar radii and 4,008 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 1, 4 and 5, HD 131873: parallax, limb-darkened diameter, radius, Teff
